findings.evidence: The opening sentence has an unmatched extra closing parenthesis after (X, \mathcal A). The intended domain is clear, so the mathematical formulas remain recoverable, but the published statement is syntactically malformed. The assigned consumer lem-signed-bl-norm-dominated-by-split-coupling-cost directly depends on this proposition.
